t: This is Dorchester Court, a building in Lambeth. Basil Catterns, who lived from 1886 to 1969, made his home here. He was Chief Cashier of the Bank of England, the senior official responsible for issuing banknotes. Since 1870, the Chief Cashier's signature has appeared on every Bank of England note. So a man whose name was printed on the nation's money lived in this building.
